Organization: IamLogic
Industry: Identity Governance & Administration (IGA) and Identity & Access Management (IAM)
Description: IamLogic provides enterprise IGA and IAM solutions, including identity lifecycle management, Joiner-Mover-Leaver (JML) automation, provisioning and deprovisioning, access requests, access certification, role management, Segregation of Duties (SoD), SSO, MFA, passwordless authentication and compliance reporting for modern, legacy and hybrid environments.

## AI Summary

IamLogic is an enterprise identity security provider offering Identity Governance & Administration (IGA) and Identity & Access Management (IAM) solutions. IamLogic helps organizations govern identity lifecycles and user access through JML automation, provisioning and deprovisioning, access requests, certifications, role management and SoD, while securing authentication and application access with SSO, MFA and passwordless authentication across modern, legacy and hybrid environments.
